description: This file defines internal test utilities and OpInfo configurations for various signal window functions in PyTorch, including sample input generators, reference implementations, error tests, and OpInfo creation for different window types, with optional scipy.signal references.

methods.name: sample_inputs_window
methods.description: Generates sample inputs for window functions with various sizes and symmetry options.

methods.name: reference_inputs_window
methods.description: Provides reference sample inputs for window functions with standard sizes.

methods.name: reference_inputs_exponential_window
methods.description: Provides reference inputs for exponential windows with specific parameters.

methods.name: reference_inputs_gaussian_window
methods.description: Provides reference inputs for Gaussian windows with specific standard deviations.

methods.name: reference_inputs_kaiser_window
methods.description: Provides reference inputs for Kaiser windows with specific beta values.

methods.name: reference_inputs_general_cosine_window
methods.description: Provides reference inputs for general cosine windows with coefficient list.

methods.name: error_inputs_window
methods.description: Generates error test cases for invalid window parameters.

methods.name: error_inputs_exponential_window
methods.description: Generates error test cases for invalid exponential window parameters.

methods.name: error_inputs_gaussian_window
methods.description: Generates error test cases for invalid Gaussian window parameters.

methods.name: error_inputs_kaiser_window
methods.description: Generates error test cases for invalid Kaiser window parameters.

methods.name: error_inputs_general_cosine_window
methods.description: Generates error test cases for invalid general cosine window parameters.

methods.name: reference_signal_window
methods.description: Wraps scipy.signal window functions for reference implementation, discarding unsupported kwargs.

methods.name: make_signal_windows_opinfo
methods.description: Creates OpInfo objects for different window functions with associated test configurations.
